description: A simple mod that allow you to open inventory in the nether portal in Minecraft

mods.name: Free Inventory
mods.description: Keep your inventory and menus open in nether portals !

releases.notes:
# 🎉 Free Inventory v1.2.3 !

Tired of your inventory closing every time you step into a Nether Portal?
**Free Inventory** fixes this vanilla annoyance by allowing you to keep your GUIs open inside portals and during teleportation.

## ➕ Changes

- Add compatibility to 26.2

## ✨ Features in v1.2.2

* ✅ **Keep Inventory Open:** Open and manage your inventory inside Nether portals.
* ✅ **No GUI Closing:** Prevents pause menu, inventory, and other screens from being forced closed by portal logic.
* ✅ **Seamless Teleportation:** You continue to be teleported even while menus are open (the game does not pause).
* ✅ **Client-Side Only:** No server installation required.
* ✅ **Mods compatibility:** Works with portals from many popular mods (The Aether, Deeper and Darker, Custom Portals)

## 🤝 Recommended Usage

For the best experience, use this mod with **[InvMove](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/invmove)**.
This allows you to walk through the portal *while* managing your inventory!

## 📦 Installation

* [CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/free-inventory)
* [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/mod/free-inventory)

## 🔄 Version

* Minecraft 1.21.x and 26.x


---
*Enjoy your seamless portal travels!*

# 🎉 First Release of Free Inventory!

Tired of your inventory closing every time you step into a Nether Portal?
**Free Inventory** fixes this vanilla annoyance by allowing you to keep your GUIs open inside portals and during teleportation.

## ✨ Features in v1.0.0

* ✅ **Keep Inventory Open:** Open and manage your inventory inside Nether portals.
* ✅ **No GUI Closing:** Prevents pause menu, inventory, and other screens from being forced closed by portal logic.
* ✅ **Seamless Teleportation:** You continue to be teleported even while menus are open (the game does not pause).
* ✅ **Client-Side Only:** No server installation required.

## 🤝 Recommended Usage

For the best experience, use this mod with **[InvMove](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/invmove)**.
This allows you to walk through the portal *while* managing your inventory!

## 📦 Installation

1.  Download the `.jar` file below.
2.  Make sure you have **Fabric Loader** installed for Minecraft 1.21.1.
3.  Drop the file into your `.minecraft/mods` folder.
4.  Ensure you have [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) installed.

## 🔄 Version

* Minecraft 1.21.1


---
*Enjoy your seamless portal travels!*
